name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: Flagship guarantee scheme by Government of Karnataka providing monthly financial assistance to female heads of eligible households.
descriptionHindi: कर्नाटक सरकार द्वारा परिवार की महिला मुखिया को आर्थिक सशक्तिकरण हेतु मासिक वित्तीय सहायता।
ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 deposited directly into the bank account of the designated female head of the family.
benefitsHindi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया के बैंक खाते में प्रति माह ₹2,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।
eligibilityText: Women registered as head of family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards in Karnataka. Woman or her husband must not be income tax or GST payers.
eligibilityTextHindi: कर्नाटक की राशन कार्ड में दर्ज महिला मुखिया, स्वयं या पति आयकरदाता या जीएसटी दाता न हों।
sourceName: Seva Sindhu Portal, Government of Karnataka
